entities.summary: Ana Patricia Botín-Sanz de Sautuola O'Shea is a Spanish banker who has been the executive chairman of Santander Group since 2014. She is the fourth generation of the Botín family to hold the role. Prior to this, she was chief executive officer (CEO) of Santander UK, a role she held from December 2010 until her assumption of the chairmanship.
